text: Program Description Cell biology is a science that studies the structure, function and various life rules of cells at the microscopic, submicroscopic and molecular levels. Cell biology is developed from cytology, a study of cell structure and function (especially chromosome). Modern cell biology studies the structure, function and life activities of cells from different levels, such as microscopic level, ultra-micro level and molecular level. Cell biology and molecular biology, neurobiology and ecology are listed as the four basic disciplines of life science in China's basic discipline development planning. Main Courses Cell development and differentiation, the advanced technology of modern molecular biology, biochemistry, cell biology, molecular biology technology, biological chemistry research technique, proteomics, modern progress in cell biology, molecular immunology principle and technology, professional foreign language, etc. Duration 3years
